author: Danny Garrison
title: The FOL Has a Website
body:
Eleven seasons in, we finally have somewhere to put all of it.

Every champion since 2016 is in the Hall of Fame, every season's standings and playoff bracket are in League History, and all eleven drafts — 1,974 picks — are in Draft History. The Managers page has everyone's title count, runner-up count, last-place count, and the player they've drafted more than anyone else.

There's also a game. Pick two teams from the league and play it out.

This is where the power rankings and weekly recaps will live from here on.
